about: Best formal result per question in the formalisation gap, with history.

entries.cls: Tag counts of the catalogue
entries.result: In our tagging: continuum 14, joint sharpness 9, smooth 4, labelled 3, distinguishability 2, local realism 1 (of 22).
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: No continuum information variable on a finite substrate
entries.result: A substrate with finitely many states has no family of non-empty pairwise-disjoint attributes indexed by R.
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: Kuypers' droplet (toy)
entries.result: Any real-valued quantity on a finite substrate misses every open interval: a finite-atom neck cannot sweep a continuum of radii.
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: Overlapping attributes cannot be distinguished
entries.result: In the deterministic theory, sending x and y to disjoint outputs is impossible if x and y overlap.
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: Disjoint attributes can be distinguished
entries.result: In the deterministic theory, disjoint x, y with inhabited outputs can be sent to disjoint outputs.
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: Spin components are q-numbers
entries.result: sigma_x sigma_z != sigma_z sigma_x over C (ConstructorTheory/QNumber.lean).
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: No state is sharp for both sigma_x and sigma_z
entries.result: No non-zero vector in C^2 is an eigenvector of both sigma_x and sigma_z (ConstructorTheory/QNumber.lean).
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: Classical copying (CT)
entries.result: In the deterministic theory every variable is an information variable: its cloning task is possible (ConstructorTheory/CTRestatement.lean).
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: No superinformation in the deterministic theory
entries.result: The deterministic (classical) theory has no superinformation medium; no-cloning and complementarity need non-classical constructors (CTRestatement.lean).
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: Changing a conserved quantity is impossible (toy principle VIII)
entries.result: In a toy thermodynamic theory whose constructors conserve U, x -> y and y -> x are both impossible when U differs (CTRestatement.lean).
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: Decreasing the monotone is impossible (toy law of impotence)
entries.result: In the toy thermodynamic theory, x -> y is impossible when the entropy-like monotone is strictly lower on y (CTRestatement.lean).
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: Constructor-based irreversibility (toy)
entries.result: A task can be possible while its transpose is impossible (CTRestatement.lean).
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: Irreversibility is not vacuous (two-state example)
entries.result: On Bool, false -> true is possible and true -> false impossible in the toy thermodynamic theory (CTRestatement.lean).
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: Breakdown is exact (Ben's thesis, schema)
entries.result: A law that is derived from and entails 'every task in X is possible' fails in a theory iff some task of X is impossible there.
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: FD forbids continuum read-outs
entries.result: Under finite distinguishability, no read-out of a continuum of bounded-energy attributes is possible.
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: FD in a deterministic theory = finite energy shells
entries.result: The deterministic theory satisfies FD on S for E iff every shell {E <= e} is finite.
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: The classical continuum violates FD for every energy function
entries.result: For any E : R -> R, the deterministic theory on a line violates FD (a countable union of finite shells cannot cover R).
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: A ladder of quanta satisfies FD
entries.result: Levels n with energy n (units of hbar*omega) have finite shells, so FD holds on the ladder.
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: No-cloning (Wootters-Zurek/Dieks), any dimension
entries.result: An inner-product-preserving map that clones psi and phi onto a normalised blank forces <psi,phi> in {0,1}.
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: Cloning non-orthogonal qubit states is an impossible task
entries.result: In any isometric two-qubit theory, cloning two states with overlap outside {0,1} is impossible.
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: The computational basis is an information variable (CNOT)
entries.result: CNOT clones {|0>, |1>} onto |0>.
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: The rotated basis {phi, phi_perp} is an information variable
entries.result: (R x R) CNOT (R^H x 1) clones {(3,4)/5, (-4,3)/5} onto |0>.
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: A variable that is not an information variable
entries.result: {|0>} and {(3|0>+4|1>)/5} are disjoint, yet cloning them is impossible (overlap 3/5).
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: The classical copying law breaks exactly at a non-orthogonal pair
entries.result: In the isometric qubit theory a pair of distinct sharp states cannot be cloned, while the basis can.
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: The quantum qubit theory is a superinformation theory
entries.result: {|0>,|1>} and {phi,phi_perp} are information variables; their union is not (Deutsch-Marletto, cloning clause).
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: Equipartition is the ceiling of the Planck factor
entries.result: x/(e^x - 1) <= 1 for x > 0: a quantised mode never holds more than k_B T on average.
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: High-frequency modes freeze out
entries.result: x/(e^x - 1) -> 0 as x -> infinity: the ultraviolet catastrophe is removed.
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: FD from Margolus-Levitin
entries.result: not formalised
entries.status: open
